mode: pre-declared conditional state-support mapping; diagnostic evidence, not Gate acceptance
evaluation_window_basis: 300-420 s is the last third of the declared 420 s run: it is far enough from the injected real initial state for the boundary conditions to act, identical for every cell, and written here before any trajectory of this batch existed

supply_axis.rationale: the real corridor is congested with low-speed waves that originate downstream of the observed segment, so the downstream boundary must be a capacity restriction; 27.78 m/s reproduces the observed geometry without restriction; the same declared values are used in every behaviour arm so that the supply axis is not confounded with the behaviour axis
supply_axis.analytic_capacity_formula: 3600 * v_lim / (v_lim * tau + length + minGap) per lane, 5 lanes

behaviour_axis.tau_source: ratio estimator of net_gap = minGap + tau * v over the full local following population of the two calibration windows, computed in step 1 before any SUMO run
behaviour_axis.single_factor_rule: an arm may differ from the sealed baseline in tau only

initial_state: each arm is initialised at t=0 with the observed real local state of its window (lanes, positions and speeds taken from the sealed canonical states); the experiment therefore measures whether the observed state is preserved by the simulated dynamics under the declared boundary supply

membership_rules.primary_state_support: the simulated evaluation-window mean (density, speed) lies inside the real pooled k-band envelope, and the fraction of simulated 30 s blocks inside that envelope is at least the data-derived cross-window baseline coverage
membership_rules.mechanism_compatibility: the fraction of simulated 30 s blocks whose density and mean closing speed lie inside the real closing-speed k-band envelope is at least the data-derived cross-window baseline, and the simulated low-speed share does not exceed the maximum observed real 30 s block low-speed share
membership_rules.baseline_definition: minimum over the two directions of 'fraction of one real window's blocks inside the other real window's envelope' -- a property of the real data, not a chosen threshold

stop_rules: any engineering failure (non-zero SUMO exit, teleport, collision) stops the batch
no cell is added to the grid after the grid has been executed
independent-seed repetition is executed only for cells that pass the primary rule
the validation window is read only after the freeze manifest exists
